prompts.name: hwj_cover_up1
prompts.prompt: Upscale and restore image 1 into a sharp, high-resolution professional studio portrait. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: the same man, identical face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, hair, expression, pose, hands under the chin, black top, gray studio background, framing and lighting. Only remove blur, JPEG artifacts and noise, and add natural fine detail (skin texture, hair strands, fabric). Do not beautify, do not change age or features, do not add or remove anything, no text, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.name: hwj_cover_up2
prompts.prompt: This is a low-resolution photo. Produce the same photo at high resolution and sharp focus, as if shot on a professional camera. The person's identity, face, expression, pose, hands, clothing, background and composition must stay identical to image 1. Only improve sharpness and clarity; no stylization, no beautification, no new elements, no text or logos.
